data.one_liner: Provides 1070 outlined Material Design icons as a single TTF font for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The package bundles a TTF font containing Material Design icons and exposes them as Flutter IconData. It works on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux, letting you use the icons like any other Flutter icon.
use_when: You need a comprehensive set of Material icons without external assets
You want a single font file for all platforms
You prefer a simple import‑only solution
avoid_when: You require custom or non‑outlined icons
You need SVG or vector assets for fine‑grained styling
Icon size or font loading overhead is a concern
strengths: Large collection of official Material icons
Zero runtime configuration, just add dependency
weaknesses: Adds a font asset to your app bundle
Limited to the icons included in the package
